summary: NN Group is european insurance group with Dutch origin, founded in 1963. Type: listed company. Not found in the IND sponsor register. 73% of its 11 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants

insights.one_liner: Dutch insurance and pensions group in The Hague; most open jobs are tech roles that show pay, but it is not an IND recognised sponsor.

culture.text: 12 of 13 open jobs are in The Hague, mostly IT, cloud and software engineering at senior level.
Staff often come from UvA, Erasmus, VU, The Hague University of Applied Sciences and Tilburg, studying economics, business, IT and finance.
Offers a wide range of training programmes and regularly surveys staff on engagement with team and manager.

open.text: Not listed as an IND recognised sponsor.
69% of its 13 jobs here don't require Dutch and 77% show the pay.
Says it employs a variety of nationalities, languages and cultures.

growth.text: Has about 16,000 colleagues serving around 18 million customers in 10 countries, and listed on Euronext Amsterdam on 2 July 2014.

worth_knowing.text: The group includes Nationale-Nederlanden, NN, ABN AMRO Insurance, Movir, AZL, BeFrank, OHRA and Woonnu.
